newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Philippines buys 55,000T U.S. and Canadian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippines buys 55,000T U.S. and Canadian wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour companies have bought 35,000 tonnes of Canadian spring and soft wheat and 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, regional traders said on Wednesday.
Two companies bought one cargo 35,000 tonnes of spring and soft wheat from Canada for May shipment, the traders said.
The price for the spring wheat is basis September futures in the Minneapolis grain exchange while the price of the soft wheat is basis September futures at the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT).
"Negotiations for June/July shipment are still ongoing," a trader involved in the purchase said.
Another Philippine firm also bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. soft wheat for prompt shipment, dealers said. No details on prices were available.
